items.description: Renew boiler, flue and storage tank
items.rationale: The burst fixed heating pipe establishes escape of water under 2.4.2(c). Sections 2.4.5 and 7.1.1(c) cover like-for-like replacement and installation of the damaged functional unit where a partial repair cannot restore it.

items.description: Adapt supply pipework to replacement boiler
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(d) covers the necessary adaptation of immediately adjoining pipework, not a wider upgrade. The estimate allows about three hours of labour plus standard fittings.
Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover removal and disposal of the unusable plant. The estimate allows for one ordinary haul and disposal charge, without duplicating installation labour.
Section 7.1.7(g) allows the first journey charge for the event. This is the first charge presented, at the reference rate of €83 for one journey.
Sections 2.4.5 and 7.1.7(e)–(f) cover testing and repair of the exposed circuits. The estimate is 12 hours at €90 gross per hour.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers like-for-like materials actually installed in the affected circuits. The estimate allows one lot of standard wiring, terminals and fixings.

items.description: Extract water from the plant room
items.rationale: Section 5.2.2 covers necessary standing-water removal as one operation, including pumping equipment and labour. The estimate is for one extraction operation, with no separate pump allowance.
Sections 4.3(d), 5.2.2 and 7.1.8(b) exclude separate payment for temporary pumping equipment, even if purchased for the job. Its cost is included in the extraction operation.
Sections 5.2.2 and 7.1.8(b) treat the pump as working equipment included in the extraction operation, not as a separately payable building component.
Section 7.1.8(d) bars the second journey charge even when billed by a different trade. The conditional estimate uses the €83 reference rate for one journey.
